Bo is familiar with PC procurement and development operations and is considered a suitable successor, according to sources in the PC supply chain.

items.title: The 346-GW question: Will anti-data-center votes slow America's AI buildout?
items.summary: US voters favored restrictions on data center development in 40 of 41 local ballot measures across 10 states on November 3, signaling growing opposition to AI infrastructure expansion.
